title: Strengths & Weaknesses
statement: Knowing myself is part of moving forward.
introduction: A place to put pieces of my own being.

items.title: Kindness
items.description: It is easy to not be kind in today's world — I choose to be kind anyway. We are all going through our own struggles, challenges, and battles that we do not let others know of — we all need kindness to be done unto us. I believe that need should be reflected in how we act towards others.

items.title: Leadership
items.description: Direction is important. Without direction, stagnation occurs and everything falls apart. I am not someone who is keen in leadership, but rather someone who merely possesses a drive to stand up — to contribute my own talents and skills, ensuring the fulfillment of an objective.

items.title: Curiosity
items.description: Curiosity drives me forward; curiosity sparks a drive within me to learn about the intricate details in life that most overlook. This enables me to possess perspectives that come from different angles and perspectives.
